def facts():
    s = CALL.upload(DEV, Q)
    spec = kt.TensorSpec.make((64, 64), "mx7a", {"gm": 16, "nk": 1})
    FM.for_port(DEV, s, np.float16, (64, 64), spec)
    key = next(k for k in s.valid if k[0] == "mx7")
    o = key[2]
    n0 = len(DEV.runs)
    FM.for_port(DEV, s, np.float16, (64, 64), spec)
    again = len(DEV.runs) - n0
    out = {
        "key": [key[0], key[1], [o.kind, o.dtype, o.offset, o.pitch, o.rows], *key[3:]],
        "bytes": s.forms[key].nbytes,
        "again_runs": again,
    }
    s.free()
    return out
